settings.title: We're reinventing the fine jewelry shopping experience: No crowds, personalized service, exceptional quality, ethical diamonds, affordable pricing, easy parking, and a glass of champagne! The way it's supposed to be.
PORTLAND OREGON

<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "FAQPage",
  "mainEntity": [{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How long will it take to get my order?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "To ensure the highest quality, all of our jewelry is handcrafted and made to order to your specifications, aside from ready-to-ship items. Once your order is received and processed, it will take 10-15 business days to craft the jewelry. Once completed, your order ships domestically via UPS 2-Day Air or internationally in approximately 5 to 7 days, depending on the destination country. Ready-to-Ship items are pre-crafted and will ship the same business day with free 2-day shipping (domestic) if ordered before 11:00 am PST, Monday through Friday. Rings needing to be resized will require two days of additional processing time. Next-day shipping is available upon request for an additional charge. Loose Stones ship in approximately 5 business days from order."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Is there a sales tax?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "All purchases made in our Portland, Oregon store and most online purchases are not charged sales tax. Should sales tax apply to your order, this will show up in your shopping cart when checking out. As of 2023, we only charge sales tax to online orders shipping to WA, CA, IL, and FL"
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Is there a MiaDonna Retail Store?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "Yes! We have a retail store located at 7279 SW Bridgeport Rd. Portland, OR 97224. Stop in and enjoy a glass of wine or a beer while shopping. Our non-commissioned lab-grown diamond and fine jewelry experts will help you find the best quality diamond at the best price. We encourage you to make an appointment (but appointments are not required) so we can make sure we have what you are looking for in stock and ready to show you. Click here to schedule your private appointment."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What should I expect at my appointment?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "In the midst of your shopping journey, take respite in an elegant lounge, where you can unwind and savor a selection of decadent refreshments. Enjoy in a glass of champagne or enjoy a perfectly brewed cup of artisanal tea, while browsing our technology, loose stones and fine jewelry with one of our expert jewelry specialists."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How long is an appointment?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "We like to keep appointments to 60 minutes long to give us adequate time to prepare for our next appointment."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "What is a virtual appointment like?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "It's exactly the same, you just have to supply your own beverage"
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Do you accept walk-ins?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "In the midst of your shopping journey, take respite in an elegant lounge, where you can unwind and savor a selection of decadent refreshments. Enjoy in a glass of champagne or enjoy a perfectly brewed cup of artisanal tea, while browsing our technology, loose stones and fine jewelry with one of our expert jewelry specialists."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "How do I change or cancel my appointment?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "To cancel or change your appointment, simply click on the appointment confirmation email."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Can I bring family and friends?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "Of course! However, we do ask that you try to keep numbers to a minimum to ensure we can give you our full attention."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Is there sales tax if I pick up my order from your Portland Oregon Store?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "In Portland, Oregon, there is a sales tax exemption. The state of Oregon does not have a statewide sales tax. Therefore, if you were to pick up an order from MiaDonna's store in Portland, you would not be charged sales tax on the purchase. Order instore or order online and select \"Portland Oregon Store pickup\" at Checkout."
    }
  },{
    "@type": "Question",
    "name": "Is your full product selection on show?",
    "acceptedAnswer": {
      "@type": "Answer",
      "text": "While we’d love to have our entire collection on display, most of our jewelry is bespoke and made just for you. If there is a particular style or diamond you’d like to see, we recommend calling us before stopping by to confirm it’s available for viewing."
    }
  }]
}
</script>
